recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast studio portrait featuring a subject in shimmering satin against a deep black void, topped with a combination of expressive psychedelic lettering and clean serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally against a total black background
High-sheen fabric highlights contrasting with deep shadows
Ornate, fluid display type paired with rigid, small-scale serif text
Warm skin tones balanced by cool, emerald-toned garments
coreInvariants: Solid black background with no visible horizon or environment
Soft-focus lighting on the face with sharp highlights on the clothing
Red-outlined display lettering with a teal/cyan fill

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered, medium shot from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and red lips, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large display text at the top, move down to the face, and follow the V-neckline of the satin garment.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the head and shoulders to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Emerald Green/Teal (satin garment and text fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the reflective satin; saturated accents in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, melting strokes with heavy bottom-weighting
Double-stroke effect with a thick outer outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'M' features a deep central dip and elongated outer legs
Final 'A' has a sweeping tail that underlines the preceding letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, liquid display lettering and rigid, geometric serif metadata.
graphicDevices: Monogram embroidery on the garment mirroring the display type style

preserve: The red/teal color combination in the text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic liquid script feel
Provides the clean, classic serif contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with dark curly hair and red lips, wearing a deep V-neck emerald green satin robe, centered against a solid black background. Lighting should be soft on the face with high-specular highlights on the satin fabric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom psychedelic script title in the top center with a teal fill and red outline. Directly below it, add a subtitle in a small, white, all-caps serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the satin have bright, reflective highlights?
Is the display text fluid and Art Nouveau inspired?
Is the subtitle clean and legible?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red outline on the text is crisp
Check that the satin texture looks metallic and fluid
Verify the subject is perfectly centered
Confirm the black background has no noise or artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Satin Texture + Black Void + Psychedelic/Serif Type Contrast
